method: Real edge-tts synthesis via EdgeTTSAdapter; audio written to MP3, duration measured with ffprobe format=duration (fallback: edge-tts WordBoundary end time, recorded per row); wpm = whitespace_token_count / (duration_s/60).
notes: Script-aware (R4-002 fix): each ur-PK voice carries a scripts dimension keyed by TTS input script. Roman rows are the canonical run above (roman_urdu_facts, measured_at 2026-10-23T00:05:54+00:00); Urdu-script rows are the same measurement run's urdu_script_facts rows in outputs/round4/tts_proof/wpm_measurements.json (measured_at 2026-10-23T00:07:43+00:00, ffprobe durations, 140 words). Top-level rates_pct/sample_text_id mirror the voice's ADOPTED default input script (urdu_script for ur-PK, roman for en-US), so script-blind lookups get the adopted default; explicit-script lookups use the scripts rows.
